title: Transform a collection
summary: Laravel: Transform a collection. Multiply by 3.
introduction: map makes a new value for every collection item. Open GET /double.

blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.

blocks.title: Transform a collection
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::get("/double", fn () => response()->json(collect([2, 3])->map(fn ($n) => $n * 2)->all()));

blocks.text: map doubles each of the two items. all extracts their array values for the response.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: map transforms values; filter chooses which values remain.
